question: Should both OpenGrep workflows fail closed after the configured curl retry envelope and a five-minute installer-process deadline?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but automation cannot choose the repository's preferred tradeoff between bounded security-runner occupancy and tolerance for unusually slow upstream installation.

options.title: Accept current bounds
options.body: Keep the 120-second curl limits and 300-second installer timeout as the shared fail-closed policy for both OpenGrep workflows.

options.title: Retune before merge
options.body: Choose different retry or subprocess deadlines and update both workflows, the guard test, and real behavior proof together.

recommendation.title: Accept current bounds
recommendation.body: Keep the 120-second curl limits and 300-second installer timeout as the shared fail-closed policy for both OpenGrep workflows.
